    // ===== State =====
    let activeCategory = 'all';
    let searchQuery = '';
    let visibleCount = 8;

    // ===== DOM References =====
    const postsGrid = document.getElementById('postsGrid');
    const showMoreBtn = document.getElementById('showMoreBtn');
    const showMoreWrap = document.getElementById('showMoreWrap');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    const categoryPills = document.querySelectorAll('.category-pill');

    // ===== Filtering Logic =====
    function getFilteredPosts() {
      return allPosts.filter(post => {
        const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'all' || post.category === activeCategory;
        const matchesSearch = !searchQuery ||
          post.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
          post.excerpt.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
          post.author.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
        return matchesCategory && matchesSearch;
      });
    }

    function renderPosts() {
      const filtered = getFilteredPosts();
      const visible = filtered.slice(0, visibleCount);

      if (visible.length === 0) {
        postsGrid.innerHTML = `
          <div class="no-results">
            <svg class="no-results-icon" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><line x1="21" x2="16.65" y1="21" y2="16.65"/><line x1="8" x2="14" y1="11" y2="11"/></svg>
            <h3>No results found</h3>
            <p>No results found at this time. Try again with a different keyword.</p>
          </div>
        `;
        showMoreWrap.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      postsGrid.innerHTML = visible.map((post, i) => `
        <a href="#" class="post-card" style="animation: fadeSlideUp 0.4s ease-out ${i * 0.05}s both">
          <span class="post-tag">${capitalize(post.category)}</span>
          <div class="post-meta">${post.date}</div>
          <h3 class="post-title">${post.title}</h3>
          <p class="post-excerpt">${post.excerpt}</p>
          <div class="post-footer">
            <div class="post-avatar">${post.initials}</div>
            <span class="post-author">${post.author}</span>
          </div>
        </a>
      `).join('');

      // Show/hide "show more" button
      if (visibleCount >= filtered.length) {
        showMoreWrap.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        showMoreWrap.style.display = 'block';
      }
    }

    function capitalize(str) {
      if (str === 'company-news') return 'Company News';
      if (str === 'v0') return 'v0';
      return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
    }

    // ===== Category Pill Click =====
    categoryPills.forEach(pill => {
      pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
        categoryPills.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
        pill.classList.add('active');
        activeCategory = pill.dataset.category;
        visibleCount = 8;
        renderPosts();
      });
    });

    // ===== Search Input =====
    let searchTimeout;
    searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
      clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
      searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        searchQuery = searchInput.value.trim();
        visibleCount = 8;
        renderPosts();
      }, 200);
    });

    // ===== Show More =====
    showMoreBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      visibleCount += 6;
      renderPosts();
    });

    // ===== Mega Menus =====
    const megaTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu-trigger');

    megaTriggers.forEach(trigger => {
      const btn = trigger.querySelector('.nav-link');
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const isOpen = trigger.classList.contains('open');
        closeAllMenus();
        if (!isOpen) {
          trigger.classList.add('open');
          btn.classList.add('open');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        }
      });
    });

    function closeAllMenus() {
      megaTriggers.forEach(t => {
        t.classList.remove('open');
        const btn = t.querySelector('.nav-link');
        btn.classList.remove('open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.mega-menu-trigger')) {
        closeAllMenus();
      }
    });

    // ===== Mobile Menu =====
    const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
    const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    const mobileNavClose = document.getElementById('mobileNavClose');

    function openMobileMenu() {
      mobileOverlay.classList.add('active');
      mobileNav.classList.add('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function closeMobileMenu() {
      mobileOverlay.classList.remove('active');
      mobileNav.classList.remove('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', openMobileMenu);
    mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);
    mobileNavClose.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);

    // ===== Scroll Reveal =====
    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });

    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

    // ===== Initial Render =====
    renderPosts();
  </script>
</body>

  <style>
    /* ===== CSS Custom Properties ===== */

    .featured-title {

      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.25;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .featured-card:first-child .featured-title {
      font-size: 30px;
    }

    .featured-excerpt {
      font-size: 14px;

    .featured-avatar {

      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      flex-shrink: 0;

    .featured-author-name {
      font-size: 13px;

      color: var(--text-secondary);

    /* ===== Latest News Grid ===== */
    .latest-section {
      padding: 48px 0;

    .latest-header {
      display: flex;

      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .latest-header h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);

      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .posts-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .post-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;

    .post-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-hover);

      transform: translateY(-2px);

    .post-tag {

      padding: 2px 10px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;

      font-weight: 600;

    .no-results {

    .no-results-icon {

    .no-results p {

    .show-more-wrap {

    .btn-show-more {

    .cta-section {
      padding: 56px 0;

    .cta-banner {
      position: relative;
      background: var(--text-primary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 56px 48px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .cta-banner::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -100px;
      right: -100px;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 114, 245, 0.2) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;

    .cta-banner::after {
      content: '';

      bottom: -60px;
      left: 40%;
      width: 300px;
      height: 300px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 114, 245, 0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;

      z-index: 1;

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 40px;

      font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 30px);
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.2;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: #fafafa;
      max-width: 520px;

    .cta-text h2 strong {
      color: #5ba3ff;
    }

    .cta-text p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #888;
      margin-top: 10px;
      max-width: 400px;
    }

      flex-shrink: 0;

      transition: all 0.15s;

      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      z-index: 150;
    }

    .mobile-nav-panel {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      width: 300px;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      z-index: 200;
      padding: 24px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      transform: translateX(100%);

      transform: translateX(0);

    .mobile-nav-close {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-close button {
      padding: 8px;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .mobile-nav-link {
      display: block;
      padding: 12px 0;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .mobile-nav-actions {
      margin-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    /* ===== Responsive ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .featured-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }

      .featured-card:first-child {
        grid-row: auto;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-links, .nav-actions { display: none; }
      .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex; }

      .mobile-overlay.active { display: block; }
      .mobile-nav-panel.active { display: block; transform: translateX(0); }

      .blog-hero { padding: 48px 0 32px; }

      .category-bar {
        overflow-x: auto;
        flex-wrap: nowrap;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
        scrollbar-width: none;
      }

      .category-bar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
      .search-input-wrap { margin-left: 0; flex-shrink: 0; }
      .search-input { width: 140px; }
      .search-input:focus { width: 180px; }

      .featured-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .featured-card:first-child .featured-title {
        font-size: 24px;
      }

      .agentic-stats {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 12px;
      }

      .posts-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .cta-content {
        flex-direction: column;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .cta-text p { margin: 10px auto 0; }
      .cta-buttons { justify-content: center; }

      .enterprise-block {
        flex-direction: column;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 24px;
      }

      .footer-bottom {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 12px;
        text-align: center;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .blog-hero h1 { font-size: 30px; }
      .featured-card { padding: 20px; }
      .featured-card:first-child { padding: 24px; }
      .cta-banner { padding: 36px 24px; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    function capitalize(str) {
      if (str === 'company-news') return 'Company News';
      if (str === 'v0') return 'v0';
      return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
    }

    // ===== Category Pill Click =====
    categoryPills.forEach(pill => {
      pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
        categoryPills.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
        pill.classList.add('active');
        activeCategory = pill.dataset.category;
        visibleCount = 8;
        renderPosts();
      });
    });

    // ===== Search Input =====
    let searchTimeout;
    searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
      clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
      searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        searchQuery = searchInput.value.trim();
        visibleCount = 8;
        renderPosts();
      }, 200);
    });

    // ===== Show More =====
    showMoreBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      visibleCount += 6;
      renderPosts();
    });

    // ===== Mega Menus =====
    const megaTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu-trigger');

    megaTriggers.forEach(trigger => {
      const btn = trigger.querySelector('.nav-link');
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const isOpen = trigger.classList.contains('open');
        closeAllMenus();
        if (!isOpen) {
          trigger.classList.add('open');
          btn.classList.add('open');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        }
      });
    });

    function closeAllMenus() {
      megaTriggers.forEach(t => {
        t.classList.remove('open');
        const btn = t.querySelector('.nav-link');
        btn.classList.remove('open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.mega-menu-trigger')) {
        closeAllMenus();
      }
    });

    // ===== Mobile Menu =====
    const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
    const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    const mobileNavClose = document.getElementById('mobileNavClose');

    function openMobileMenu() {
      mobileOverlay.classList.add('active');
      mobileNav.classList.add('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function closeMobileMenu() {
      mobileOverlay.classList.remove('active');
      mobileNav.classList.remove('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', openMobileMenu);
    mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);
    mobileNavClose.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);

    // ===== Scroll Reveal =====
    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });

    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

    // ===== Initial Render =====
    renderPosts();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

The DeployCloud Blog is complete at `/app/output/index.html`. Here's what's built:

**Design direction**: Editorial/Magazine tone with light background (#FAFAFA), deep navy text (#171717), and electric blue accent (#0072F5). Typography uses Space Grotesk for headlines and Plus Jakarta Sans for body — distinctive, not generic.

**All required sections implemented**:

1. **Header** with sticky glassmorphic nav, Products mega menu (AI Cloud, Core Platform, Security columns with descriptions), Resources dropdown (Company, Learn, Open Source), and Ask AI / Log In / Sign Up actions. Mobile hamburger menu included.

2. **Category filters** — 9 pill buttons (All Posts, Engineering, Community, Company News, Customers, v0, Security, Changelog, Press) with active state styling. Search input with expanding focus effect. Both filters work together seamlessly.

3. **Featured articles** — 3 cards in an asymmetric grid. The lead card (Agentic Infrastructure) spans two rows with dark background and woven-in stats (30%, 1000%, 20x). Two supporting cards for durable execution and agent responsibility.

4. **Latest news grid** — 3-column responsive grid with 8 posts initially loaded from 14 total. Category tags, dates, titles, excerpts, author avatars. "Show more posts" progressively reveals 6 more cards at a time.

5. **CTA banner** — Dark background with radial gradient atmosphere. Free account + Pro/Enterprise messaging. Enterprise exploration block.

6. **Footer** — 10-column link grid (Get Started, Build, Scale, Secure, Resources, Learn, Frameworks, SDKs, Use Cases, Company) with social icons and system status indicator.

**Interactions**: Category filtering, search with debounced input, show-more progressive loading, mega menu dropdowns, mobile slide-out nav, scroll-triggered reveal animations, and a "no results" state.
